request.style: English, deep male soul voice, solo with choir harmonies, warm piano, soft strings, gentle bass, light percussion, mournful and reflective, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Terah lived seventy years in Ur
He became the father of three sons
Abram and Nahor and Haran
Their story begins in the dust

[Verse]
Haran became the father of Lot
And Milcah and Iscah as well
In the land where his roots were found
Before the long journey began

[Chorus]
Haran died in the land of his birth
In Ur of the Chaldeans he slept
While his father Terah was still alive
His life ended before the move

[Verse]
Abram and Nahor took wives
Sarai for Abram and Milcah for Nahor
The daughter of Haran is named
In the record of Terah's house

[Chorus]
Haran died in the land of his birth
In Ur of the Chaldeans he slept
While his father Terah was still alive
His life ended before the move

[Bridge]
The account of Terah is clear
Haran the father of Lot
He stayed behind in the city
Before the family moved to Canaan

[Chorus]
Haran died in the land of his birth
In Ur of the Chaldeans he slept
While his father Terah was still alive
His life ended before the move

[Outro]
Haran died in the land of his birth
In Ur of the Chaldeans he slept
